miniVite

Accelerate Bench task · Numerics, tensors & graphs

miniVite identifies communities in a weighted graph using the first phase of distributed Louvain clustering.

Task version11.1.0CPU budget4 CPUsMemory6 GiBAgent budget8 hoursHarbor HubOpen task ↗

Workload

Each MPI run reads a generated graph, exchanges community assignments and iterates until convergence.

Correctness

The current and target partition for every vertex at every iteration must match the reference up to community-label renaming. Repeated runs must reproduce the same output.

Timing

Timing covers the entire MPI process.
